The Commission of Truth and Friendship that exists between **Indonesia** (the country where Sambas is located) and a newly‑independent nation is the one set up with **Timor‑Leste (East Timor)**.  
Since 2022 the president of that newly‑declared independent country is **José Manuel Ramos‑Horta**. He assumed office on 20 May 2022 after winning the presidential election and is currently serving as the head of state of Timor‑Leste.
